name: Workflows
description: Workflow runtime — enforces step-by-step agent execution with gated delivery, parallel steps, human gates, and output validation

apiRoutes.summary: List all workflow templates with step counts and resolved sub-workflows
Create a new user-owned workflow definition
Get a specific workflow definition by name
Update or shadow a workflow definition (writes user YAML)
Reject a gate step, rewinds workflow
Render a durable Bakin gate approval fallback page
Approve or reject a gate through the durable Bakin approval fallback page
Batch check gate status for tasks
List active workflow instances. Optional status filter.
Get full workflow instance state for a task
Start a workflow instance for a task
List registered workflow node types (builtin + plugin-registered) for the canvas palette
Get current workflow step for a task
Submit step output, validates against schema, advances workflow

execTools.name: bakin_exec_workflows_complete_step
execTools.summary: Complete a workflow step with output
execTools.description: Complete a workflow step with output. Validates output against the step schema, advances the workflow to the next step. Returns success status and whether the workflow is complete.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_workflows_get_definition
execTools.summary: Get a workflow definition by filename
execTools.description: Get a workflow definition by filename. Returns the full definition with steps, inputs, and resolved sub-workflows.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_workflows_get_instance
execTools.summary: Get the full state of a workflow instance for a task, including step states and history
execTools.description: Get the full state of a workflow instance for a task, including step states and history.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_workflows_get_step
execTools.summary: Get the current workflow step for a task
execTools.description: Get the current workflow step for a task. Returns only the current step (information gating — future steps are hidden). Critical for agents to know what to do next.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_workflows_list
execTools.description: List all workflow definitions (templates). Returns name, filename, description, and step count for each.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_workflows_list_instances
execTools.description: List workflow instances. Optionally filter by status (in_progress, pending_approval, complete, failed, cancelled).

execTools.name: bakin_exec_workflows_start
execTools.summary: Start a workflow instance for a task
execTools.description: Start a workflow instance for a task. The task must exist on the board. Returns the created instance.
